implementation: Round 2 Receiving Manager. With photos in data/input/<unit>/receiving/ and AI_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY set: order-blind vision model reads SKU, counts, variant, damage and components from the photos, then a deterministic decision engine compares them with the PO (7 checks; unseen values are UNCERTAIN, never assumed). Without photos or a key: the same rules over the operator's recorded counts, disclosed as model 'receiving-rules', calls 0, payload.method 'operator_counts'.
notes: Vision failure is fail-open: a pending record with error code model_error, routed to human review. Vision path needs the openai package.
